issue.title: Extend the missing_gate_shell_row guard from custom gates to built-in shell-backed gate kinds
issue.description:
Proposed by phase bead sase-14n.15.3 (PROPOSED FOLLOW-UP note #1) and filed by the sase-14n.15 land agent.

c6807d24c made `validate_gate_spec` (src/sase/notification_gates/validation.py) raise `missing_gate_shell_row` when a spec with a `shell` block reaches `notification_gates.service.create_gate` without `shell_row_managed=True`. The gate-shell transaction (`sase.gate_shell.transaction._spec_from_request`) is the only production caller that sets that marker. The guard is limited to `adapter.kind == "custom"`.

The gap: a direct `create_gate` call with a shell block on a built-in shell-backed kind (sudo, plan, question, HITL, launch) still succeeds and records `continuation_mode="gate_shell"` without a gate-shell row, so the gate is missing from `sase gate list`. sase-14n.15.3 checked every src caller and found that each one either routes shell specs through `create_gate_shell` or passes shell-free specs, so production is covered today. Only a new direct caller would reintroduce the sase-14g failure.

Remediation: drop the `kind == "custom"` restriction, or extend the guard to every kind whose spec carries a shell block. Migrate the built-in-kind tests that call `create_gate` directly with shell specs so they go through `create_gate_shell`, or have them set `shell_row_managed` explicitly when they build their own rows.

task_type_fields.proposal: Refuse rowless shell-bearing create_gate calls for every gate kind, not just custom, and migrate the built-in-kind tests to create_gate_shell
task_type_fields.why_out_of_scope: sase-14n.15.3 limited the guard to kind=custom so the phase stayed medium and the built-in gate suites stayed green; production callers are already covered, so this is hardening rather than a fix for sase-14g

payload.description: sase-14g is the rowless-gate bug this guard hardens against
